integrity: The proof uses the source's critical-point, properness, monodromy-invariance, and minimum characterizations together with contractibility of Teichmuller space and the weak Morse inequality. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on the descended harmonic energy on the cyclic Teichmuller quotient being Morse. No genericity, embeddedness of the index-one immersion, or quantitative energy gap is claimed.
title: Morse energy forces an index-one branched minimal fiber
